}\n854\t\n855\t    if let Some(peak) = info.peak_rss_bytes {\n856\t        println!(\"  Peak RSS: {}\", crate::daemon::format_bytes(peak));\n857\t    }\n858\t\n859\t    if let Some(sessions) = &crate::daemon::DaemonInfo) {\n    if !info.running {\n        println!(\"Daemon: stopped\");\n\n        // Print health warning even when stopped (e.g., stale last_scrape)\n        if let Some(ref health) = info.health {\n            if health == \"critical\" || health == \"stale\" {\n                if let Some(ref message) = info.health_message {\n                    println!();\n                    println!(\"  ⚠️  {}\", message);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        return;\n    }\n\n    println!(\"Daemon: running\");\n\n    if let Some(pid) = info.pid {\n     );\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// Run search command\n#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]\nfn run_search(\n    query: Option<String>,\n    error: Option<String>,\n    code: Option<String>,\n    lang: Option<String>,\n    solution_only: bool,\n    like: Option<String>,\n    session: Option<String>,\n    agent: Vec<String>,\n    project: Option<String>,\n    since: run_index(action: IndexAction) -> Result<()> {\n    let config = load_config()?;\n    let data_dir = config.data_dir()?;\n\n    if !data_dir.exists() {\n        eprintln!(\"AgentScribe not initialized. Run 'agentscribe config init' to set up.\");\n        std::process::exit(1);\n    }\n\n    match action {\n        IndexAction::Rebuild { plugin, heap_size } => {\n            run_index_rebuild(&data_dir, plugin.as_deref(), heap_size)\n        }\n        IndexAction::Stats => run_index_stats(&data_dir),\n        IndexAction::Optimize => run_index_optimize(&data_dir),\n    }\n}\n\n/// Run index rebuild: drop existing index and rebuild from session files.\nfn run_index_rebuild(\n    data_dir: &std::path::Path,\n    plugin_filter: Option<&str>,\n    heap_size: usize,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    let sessions_dir = data_dir.join(\"sessions\");\n\n    if !sessions_dir.exists() {\n        eprintln!(\"No sessions directory found. Run 'agentscribe scrape' first.\");\n        std::process::exit(2);\n    }\n\n    // Drop existing index\n    let index_path = data_dir.join(\"index\").join(\"tantivy\");\n    if index_path.exists() {\n        println!(\"Dropping existing index...\");\n        std::fs::remove_dir_all(&index_path)?;\n    }\n\n    let mut manager = IndexManager::open(data_dir)?;\n    manager.set_heap_size(heap_size);\n    manager.begin_write()?;\n\n    let mut total_docs = 0usize;\n    let mut total_errors = 0usize;\n\n    // Walk session directories\n    let entries = match std::fs::read_dir(&sessions_dir) {\n        Ok(e) => e,\n        Err(_) => {\n            eprintln!(\"Cannot read sessions directory.\");\n            std::process::exit(2);\n        }\n    };\n\n    for agent_entry in entries.filter_map(|e| e.ok()) {\n        let agent_path = agent_entry.path();\n        if !agent_path.is_dir() {\n            continue;\n        }\n\n        let agent_name = match agent_path.file_name().and_then(|n| n.to_str()) {\n            Some(n) => n.to_string(),\n            None => continue,\n        };\n\n        // Apply plugin filter\n        if let Some(filter) = plugin_filter {\n            if agent_name != filter {\n                continue;\n            }\n        }\n\n        let session_files = match std::fs::read_dir(&agent_path) {\n            Ok(e) => e,\n            Err(_) => continue,\n        };\n\n        for session_entry in session_files.filter_map(|e| e.ok()) {\n            let session_path = session_entry.path();\n            if session_path.extension().and_then(|e| e.to_str()) != Some(\"jsonl\") {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            let session_id = format!(\n                \"{}/{}\",\n                agent_name,\n                session_path\n                    .file_stem()\n                    .and_then(|s| s.to_str())\n                    .unwrap_or(\"unknown\")\n            );\n\n            // Read events from the normalized session file\n            let file = match std::fs::File::open(&session_path) {\n                Ok(f) => f,\n                Err(e) => {\n                    eprintln!(\"Error reading {}: {}\", session_path.display(), e);\n                    total_errors += 1;\n                    continue;\n                }\n            };\n\n            use std::io::BufRead;\n            let reader = std::io::BufReader::new(file);\n            let mut events = Vec::new();\n\n            for line in reader.lines() {\n                match line {\n                    Ok(l) => {\n                        if let Ok(event) = crate::event::Event::from_jsonl(&l) {\n                            events.push(event);\n                        }\n                    }\n                    Err(_) => {\n                        total_errors += 1;\n                        continue;\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n\n            if events.is_empty() {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            // Build manifest from events\n            let first = &events[0];\n            let manifest = crate::index::build_manifest_from_events(\n                &events,\n                &session_id,\n                &agent_name,\n                first.project.as_deref(),\n                first.model.as_deref(),\n                None,\n            );\n\n            match manager.index_session(&events, &manifest) {\n                Ok(_) => total_docs += 1,\n                Err(e) => {\n                    eprintln!(\"Error indexing {}: {}\", session_id, e);\n                    total_errors += 1;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    manager.finish()?;\n\n    println!(\n        \"Rebuilt index from {} session files ({} errors)\",\n        total_docs, total_errors\n    );\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// Show index statistics.\nfn run_index_stats(data_dir: &std::path::Path) -> Result<()> {\n    let index_path = data_dir.join(\"index\").join(\"tantivy\");\n\n    if !index_path.exists() {\n        println!(\"Index not found. Run 'agentscribe scrape' first.\");\n        return Ok(());\n    }\n\n    let index = match search::open_index(data_dir) {\n        Ok(i) => i,\n        Err(e) => {\n            eprintln!(\"Error opening index: {}\", e);\n            std::process::exit(1);\n        }\n    };\n\n    let reader = index.reader().map_err(|e| {\n        crate::error::AgentScribeError::DataDir(format!(\"Failed to create reader: {}\", e))\n    })?;\n    let searcher = reader.searcher();\n\n    let num_docs = searcher.num_docs();\n    let segments = index.searchable_segment_metas().map_err(|e| {\n        crate::error::AgentScribeError::DataDir(format!(\"Failed to get segment metas: {}\", e))\n    })?;\n    let num_segments = segments.len();\n    let schema = index.schema();\n    let fields: Vec<String> = schema\n        .fields()\n        .map(|(field, _)| schema.get_field_name(field).to_string())\n        .collect();\n\n    let size_bytes = dir_size(&index_path);\n\n    println!(\"Tantivy index at {}\", index_path.display());\n    println!(\"  Documents:    {}\", num_docs);\n    println!(\"  Segments:     {}\", num_segments);\n    println!(\"  Size on disk: {}\", format_bytes(size_bytes));\n    println!(\"  Fields:       {}\", fields.join(\", \"));\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// Optimize the index by merging segments.\nfn run_index_optimize(data_dir: &std::path::Path) -> Result<()> {\n    let index_path = data_dir.join(\"index\").join(\"tantivy\");\n\n    if !index_path.exists() {\n        println!(\"Index not found. Run 'agentscribe scrape' first.\");\n        return Ok(());\n    }\n\n    let pre_size = dir_size(&index_path);\n\n    let index = search::open_index(data_dir)?;\n    let segment_ids = index.searchable_segment_ids().map_err(|e| {\n        crate::error::AgentScribeError::DataDir(format!(\"Failed to get segment IDs: {}\", e))\n    })?;\n    let num_segments = segment_ids.len();\n\n    println!(\"Merging {} segments...\", num_segments);\n\n    let mut writer = index\n        .writer::<tantivy::TantivyDocument>(50_000_000)\n        .map_err(|e| {\n            crate::error::AgentScribeError::DataDir(format!(\"Failed to open writer: {}\", e))\n        })?;\n\n    // Merge all segments into one and wait for completion\n    writer.merge(&segment_ids).wait().map_err(|e| {\n        crate::error::AgentScribeError::DataDir(format!(\"Failed to merge segments: {}\", e))\n    })?;\n    writer.garbage_collect_files().wait().map_err(|e| {\n        crate::error::AgentScribeError::DataDir(format!(\"Failed to garbage collect: {}\", e))\n    })?;\n\n    let post_size = dir_size(&index_path);\n\n    println!(\n        \"Merged {} segments ({} → {})\",\n        num_segments,\n        format_bytes(pre_size),\n        format_bytes(post_size)\n    );\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// Run status command\nfn run_status(json: bool, plugin_filter: Option<String>) -> Result<()> {\n    let config = load_config()?;\n    let data_dir = config.data_dir()?;\n    let data_dir_str = data_dir.display().to_string();\n\n    if !data_dir.exists() {\n        eprintln!(\"AgentScribe not initialized. Run 'agentscribe config init' to set up.\");\n        std::process::exit(1);\n    }\n\n    let mut scraper = Scraper::new(data_dir.clone())?;\n    scraper.load_plugins()?;\n\n    // Determine which u64;\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        _total_events += plugin_events;\n\n        // Get source paths and truncation_limit from plugin config\n        let (source_paths, truncation_limit) = scraper\n            .plugin_manager()\n            .get(plugin_name)\n            .map(|p| (p.source.paths.clone(), p.source.truncation_limit))\n            .unwrap_or_default();\n\n        // Find last scraped time and byte totals from scrape state for this plugin\n        let plugin_files: Vec<_> = scrape_state\n            .sources\n            .iter()\n            .filter(|(_, s)| s.plugin == *plugin_name)\n            .collect();\n\n        let last_scraped = plugin_files.iter().map(|(_, s)| s.last_scraped).max();\n\n        let mut plugin_bytes: u64 = 0;\n        for (_, file_state) in &plugin_files {\n            plugin_bytes += file_state.last_byte_offset;\n            total_bytes += file_state.last_byte_offset;\n        }\n        total_sources += plugin_files.len();\n\n        plugin_statuses.push(PluginStatus {\n            name: plugin_name.to_string(),\n            sessions: sessions.len(),\n            events: plugin_events,\n            last_scraped,\n            source_paths,\n            source_files: plugin_files.len(),\n            bytes: plugin_bytes,\n            truncation_limit,\n            subagent_sessions: subagent_session_count,\n            subagent_events: subagent_event_count,\n        });\n    }\n\n    // Daemon state (Phase 4 - check PID file if it exists)\n    let daemon_status = get_daemon_status(&data_dir);\n\n    // Disk usage of data directory\n    let dir_bytes = dir_size(&data_dir);\n\n    // Index stats (Phase 2 - check if index directory exists)\n    let index_dir = data_dir.join(\"index\");\n    let index_stats = get_index_stats(&index_dir);\n\n    if json {\n        use serde_json::json;\n        let mut plugins_json = Vec::new();\n        for ps in &plugin_statuses {\n            let mut p = json!({\n                \"name\": ps.name,\n                \"sessions\": ps.sessions,\n                \"events\": ps.events,\n                \"source_files\": ps.source_files,\n                \"bytes\": ps.bytes,\n                \"source_paths\": ps.source_paths,\n                \"subagent_sessions\": ps.subagent_sessions,\n                \"subagent_events\": ps.subagent_events,\n            });\n            if let Some(ts) = ps.last_scraped {\n                p[\"last_scraped\"] = json!(ts.to_rfc3339());\n            } else {\n                p[\"last_scraped\"] = json!(null);\n            }\n            plugins_json.push(p);\n        }\n\n        let status = json!({\n            \"version\": env!(\"CARGO_PKG_VERSION\"),\n            \"data_dir\": data_dir_str,\n            \"data_dir_bytes\": dir_bytes,\n            \"plugins\": plugins_json,\n            \"scrape_state\": {\n                \"tracked_sources\": total_sources,\n                \"total_bytes\": total_bytes,\n            },\n            \"daemon\": {\n                \"running\": daemon_status.running,\n                \"pid\": daemon_status.pid,\n            },\n            \"index\": {\n                \"exists\": index_stats.exists,\n                \"documents\": index_stats.documents,\n                \"size_bytes\": index_stats.size_bytes,\n            },\n        });\n\n        println!(\"{}\", serde_json::to_string_pretty(&status).unwrap());\n    } else {\n        println!(\"AgentScribe v{}\", env!(\"CARGO_PKG_VERSION\"));\n        println!(\"Data dir: {} ({})\", data_dir_str, format_bytes(dir_bytes));\n\n        // Daemon\n        if daemon_status.running {\n            if let Some(pid) = daemon_status.pid {\n                println!(\"Daemon: running (PID {})\", pid);\n            } else {\n                println!(\"Daemon: running\");\n            }\n        } else {\n            println!(\"Daemon: stopped\");\n        }\n\n        // Plugins\n        println!(\"\\nPlugins:\");\n        if plugin_statuses.is_empty() {\n            println!(\"  (none)\");\n        }\n        for ps in &plugin_statuses {\n            let last = match ps.last_scraped {\n                Some(ts) => format_ago(ts),\n                None => \"never scraped\".to_string(),\n            };\n\n            // Display main sessions\n            let main_sessions = ps.sessions - ps.subagent_sessions;\n            let main_events = ps.events - ps.subagent_events;\n\n            println!(\n                \"  {:<14} {:>4} sessions  {:>6} events  {}  ({} source files, {})\",\n                ps.name,\n                main_sessions,\n                main_events,\n                last,\n                ps.source_files,\n                format_bytes(ps.bytes)\n            );\n\n            // Display subagent sessions if any exist\n            if ps.subagent_sessions > 0 {\n                println!(\n                    \"    └─ subagent sessions: {:>4} sessions  {:>6} events\",\n                    ps.subagent_sessions, ps.subagent_events\n                );\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Windsurf truncation warning\n        for ps in &plugin_statuses {\n            if ps.name == \"windsurf\" {\n                if let Some(limit) = ps.truncation_limit {\n                    println!(\n                        \"\\n  WARNING: Windsurf retains at most {} conversations.\",\n                        limit\n                    );\n                    println!(\n                        \"  Old conversations are silently overwritten. Run 'agentscribe scrape'\"\n                    );\n                    println!(\n                        \"  frequently (e.g., via 'agentscribe daemon start') to avoid data loss.\"\n                    );\n                    break;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Index\n        if index_stats.exists {\n            println!(\n                \"\\nIndex: {} documents, {} on disk\",\n                index_stats.documents,\n                format_bytes(index_stats.size_bytes)\n            );\n        } else {\n            println!(\"\\nIndex: not built (run 'agentscribe index rebuild')\");\n        }\n\n        // Scrape state\n        println!(\n            \"\\nScrape state: tracking offsets for {} source paths ({} total)\",\n            total_sources,\n            format_bytes(total_bytes)\n        );\n    }\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// Run embed subcommands\nfn run_embed(action: EmbedAction) -> Result<()> {\n    let config = load_config()?;\n    let data_dir = config.data_dir()?;\n\n    if !data_dir.exists() {\n        eprintln!(\"AgentScribe not initialized. Run 'agentscribe config init' to set up.\");\n        std::process::exit(1);\n    }\n\n    // Check if vector index is enabled\n    if !config.vector.enabled {\n        eprintln!(\"Vector index is disabled. Enable it in config.toml:\");\n        eprintln!(\"\\n[vector]\");\n        eprintln!(\"enabled = true\");\n        eprintln!(\"\\nThen run 'agentscribe embed build' again.\");\n        std::process::exit(1);\n    }\n\n    // Check if vector index is actually functional (not stub mode)\n    // This detects if turbovec dependency is commented out due to BLAS linking issues\n    let test_index = crate::vector::VectorIndex::new(\n        data_dir.clone(),\n        config.vector.clone(),\n        768, // Will be updated when client is created\n    );\n    if !test_index.is_functional() {\n        eprintln!(\"❌ Vector search is currently non-functional (stub mode).\");\n        eprintln!(\"\\nThe turbovec dependency is disabled due to BLAS library linking issues.\");\n        eprintln!(\"\\nWhat this means:\");\n        eprintln!(\"  • 'agentscribe embed build' creates dummy indexes\");\n        eprintln!(\"  • 'agentscribe search --semantic' returns meaningless results\");\n        eprintln!(\"  • No real semantic search is happening\");\n        eprintln!(\"\\nTo restore functionality:\");\n        eprintln!(\"  1. Uncomment turbovec dependency in Cargo.toml\");\n        eprintln!(\"  2. Resolve BLAS/cblas_sgemm linking issues\");\n        eprintln!(\"  3. Uncomment turbovec code in src/vector.rs\");\n        eprintln!(\"\\nSee src/vector.rs for detailed restoration steps.\");\n        std::process::exit(1);\n    }\n\n    match action {\n        EmbedAction::Build { plugin, concurrent } => {\n            run_embed_build(&data_dir, &config, plugin.as_deref(), concurrent)\n        }\n        EmbedAction::Rebuild { plugin, concurrent } => {\n            run_embed_rebuild(&data_dir, &config, plugin.as_deref(), concurrent)\n        }\n        EmbedAction::Stats => run_embed_stats(&data_dir, &config),\n        EmbedAction::Missing { json } => run_embed_missing(&data_dir, json),\n    }\n}\n\n/// Build embeddings for unembedded sessions\nfn run_embed_build(\n    data_dir: &std::path::Path,\n    config: &crate::config::Config,\n    plugin_filter: Option<&str>,\n    _concurrent: usize,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    use crate::vector::EmbedState;\n\n    let vector_config = config.vector.clone();\n\n    // Check if vector index is in stub mode (turbovec disabled due to BLAS linking issues)\n    // The stub mode writes a marker file \"STUB: turbovec disabled\" to the index file\n    let sessions_index_path = data_dir.join(\"index\").join(\"vector\").join(\"sessions.tvim\");\n    if sessions_index_path.exists() {\n        if let Ok(content) = std::fs::read(&sessions_index_path) {\n            if content.starts_with(b\"STUB: turbovec disabled\") {\n                return Err(AgentScribeError::DataDir(\n                    \"Vector search is currently non-functional (stub mode). The turbovec dependency is disabled due to BLAS library linking issues. \\\n                    See src/vector.rs for details on restoring functionality. \\\n                    Until then, 'agentscribe embed build' cannot create real semantic indexes.\".to_string()\n                ));\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    println!(\"Building vector index...\");\n    println!(\"  Model: {}\", vector_config.embedding_model);\n    println!(\n        \"  Dimension: {}\",\n        if vector_config.embedding_model.starts_with(\"openai:\") {\n            1536\n        } else {\n            768\n        }\n    );\n    println!(\"  Chunk size: {} tokens\", vector_config.chunk_size_tokens);\n\n    // Load embed state to track progress\n    let state_path = data_dir.join(\"state\").join(\"embed-state.json\");\n    let mut embed_state = EmbedState::load(&state_path).unwrap_or_default();\n\n    // Create embedding client\n    let client = crate::embedding::create_client(&vector_config)?;\n    let embedding_dim = client.dimension();\n\n    // Load or create vector index\n    let mut vector_index = crate::vector::VectorIndex::load_or_create(\n        data_dir.to_path_buf(),\n        vector_config.clone(),\n        embedding_dim,\n    )?;\n\n    // Check if the vector index is functional (not in stub mode)\n    if !vector_index.is_functional() {\n        return Err(AgentScribeError::DataDir(\n            \"Vector search is currently non-functional (stub mode). The turbovec dependency is disabled due to BLAS library linking issues. \\\n            See src/vector.rs for details on restoring functionality. \\\n            Until then, 'agentscribe embed build' cannot create real semantic indexes.\".to_string()\n        ));\n    }\n\n    // Get sessions directory\n    let sessions_dir = data_dir.join(\"sessions\");\n    if !sessions_dir.exists() {\n        eprintln!(\"No sessions directory found. Run 'agentscribe scrape' first.\");\n        std::process::exit(1);\n    }\n\n    // Collect session IDs to embed\n    let mut sessions_to_embed = Vec::new();\n\n    for agent_entry in std::fs::read_dir(&sessions_dir)? {\n        let agent_entry = match agent_entry {\n            Ok(e) => e,\n            Err(_) => continue,\n        };\n        let agent_path = agent_entry.path();\n        if !agent_path.is_dir() {\n            continue;\n        }\n\n        let agent_name = match agent_path.file_name().and_then(|n| n.to_str()) {\n            Some(n) => n.to_string(),\n            None => continue,\n        };\n\n        // Apply plugin filter\n        if let Some(filter) = plugin_filter {\n            if agent_name != *filter {\n                continue;\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Walk session files\n        if let Ok(session_entries) = std::fs::read_dir(&agent_path) {\n            for session_entry in session_entries.flatten() {\n                let session_path = session_entry.path();\n                if session_path.extension().and_then(|e| e.to_str()) != Some(\"jsonl\") {\n                    continue;\n                }\n\n                let session_id = format!(\n                    \"{}/{}\",\n                    agent_name,\n                    session_path\n                        .file_stem()\n                        .and_then(|s| s.to_str())\n                        .unwrap_or(\"unknown\")\n                );\n\n                // Skip if already embedded\n                if embed_state.is_session_embedded(&session_id) {\n                    continue;\n                }\n\n                sessions_to_embed.push((session_id, session_path));\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    if sessions_to_embed.is_empty() {\n        println!(\"All sessions already embedded.\");\n        return Ok(());\n    }\n\n    println!(\"Found {} sessions to embed\", sessions_to_embed.len());\n\n    // Embed sessions\n    let mut embedded_count = 0;\n    let mut error_count = 0;\n\n    let total_sessions = sessions_to_embed.len();\n    for (session_id, session_path) in sessions_to_embed {\n        // Read session events\n        let events = match read_session_events(&sessions_dir, &session_id) {\n            Ok(e) if !e.is_empty() => e,\n            Ok(_) => continue,\n            Err(e) => {\n                eprintln!(\"Error reading {}: {}\", session_path.display(), e);\n                error_count += 1;\n                continue;\n            }\n        };\n\n        // Build session text for embedding\n        let session_text = crate::vector::build_session_text(&events);\n\n        // Embed session-level\n        if vector_config.index_sessions {\n            match client.embed(&session_text) {\n                Ok(embedding) => {\n                    vector_index.upsert_session(&session_id, embedding)?;\n                    embed_state.mark_session_embedded(session_id.clone());\n                }\n                Err(e) => {\n                    eprintln!(\"Error embedding {}: {}\", session_id, e);\n                    error_count += 1;\n                    continue;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Embed chunks if enabled\n        if vector_config.index_chunks {\n            let chunks = crate::vector::chunk_session_text(\n                &session_text,\n                vector_config.chunk_size_tokens,\n                vector_config.chunk_overlap_tokens,\n            );\n\n            for (idx, chunk_text) in chunks.into_iter().enumerate() {\n                let chunk_id = format!(\"{}#{}\", session_id, idx);\n\n                match client.embed(&chunk_text) {\n                    Ok(embedding) => {\n                        vector_index.upsert_chunk(&chunk_id, embedding)?;\n                        embed_state.mark_chunk_embedded(chunk_id);\n                    }\n                    Err(e) => {\n                        eprintln!(\"Error embedding chunk {}: {}\", chunk_id, e);\n                        error_count += 1;\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        embedded_count += 1;\n\n        // Save index periodically\n        if embedded_count % 10 == 0 {\n            vector_index.save()?;\n            embed_state.save(&state_path)?;\n            println!(\"  Progress: {}/{}\", embedded_count, total_sessions);\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Final save\n    vector_index.save()?;\n    embed_state.save(&state_path)?;\n\n    println!(\"Embedded {} sessions\", embedded_count);\n    if error_count > 0 {\n        eprintln!(\"Errors: {}\", error_count);\n    }\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// Rebuild the entire vector index\nfn run_embed_rebuild(\n    data_dir: &std::path::Path,\n    config: &crate::config::Config,\n    plugin_filter: Option<&str>,\n    _concurrent: usize,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    eprintln!(\"⚠️  WARNING: Vector search is currently STUBBED and NON-FUNCTIONAL.\");\n    eprintln!(\"    The turbovec dependency is disabled due to BLAS library linking issues.\");\n    eprintln!(\"    This command will create placeholder indexes but provides no real semantic search capability.\");\n    eprintln!(\"    See src/vector.rs for details on restoring functionality.\\n\");\n\n    println!(\"Rebuilding vector index from scratch...\");\n\n    let vector_config = config.vector.clone();\n\n    // Delete existing indexes\n    let temp_index = crate::vector::VectorIndex::new(\n        data_dir.to_path_buf(),\n        vector_config.clone(),\n        768, // Will be updated when client is created\n    );\n\n    if temp_index.sessions_index_exists() {\n        println!(\"  Deleting existing session index...\");\n        temp_index.delete_sessions_index()?;\n    }\n\n    if temp_index.chunks_index_exists() {\n        println!(\"  Deleting existing chunk index...\");\n        temp_index.delete_chunks_index()?;\n    }\n\n    // Reset embed state\n    let state_path = data_dir.join(\"state\").join(\"embed-state.json\");\n    let _ = std::fs::remove_file(&state_path);\n\n    // Run build with all sessions\n    run_embed_build(data_dir, config, plugin_filter, 1)?;\n\n    println!(\"Rebuild complete.\");\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// Show vector index statistics\nfn run_embed_stats(data_dir: &std::path::Path, config: &crate::config::Config) -> Result<()> {\n    let vector_config = config.vector.clone();\n\n    // Create embedding client to get dimension\n    let client = crate::embedding::create_client(&vector_config)?;\n    let embedding_dim = client.dimension();\n\n    // Load vector index\n    let vector_index = match crate::vector::VectorIndex::load_or_create(\n        data_dir.to_path_buf(),\n        vector_config.clone(),\n        embedding_dim,\n    ) {\n        Ok(idx) => idx,\n        Err(_) => {\n            println!(\"Vector index not found. Run 'agentscribe embed build' first.\");\n            return Ok(());\n        }\n    };\n\n    // Load embed state\n    let state_path = data_dir.join(\"state\").join(\"embed-state.json\");\n    let embed_state = crate::vector::EmbedState::load(&state_path).unwrap_or_default();\n\n    println!(\"Vector index statistics\");\n    println!(\"  Model: {}\", vector_config.embedding_model);\n    println!(\"  Dimension: {}\", embedding_dim);\n    println!(\"  Bit width: {}-bit\", vector_config.bit_width);\n    println!(\"  Sessions embedded: {}\", vector_index.session_count());\n    println!(\"  Chunks embedded: {}\", vector_index.chunk_count());\n    println!(\n        \"  Tracked in state: {} sessions, {} chunks\",\n        embed_state.embedded_sessions.len(),\n        embed_state.embedded_chunks.len()\n    );\n\n    let index_dir = data_dir.join(\"index\").join(\"vector\");\n    if index_dir.exists() {\n        let size_bytes = dir_size(&index_dir);\n        println!(\"  Size on disk: {}\", format_bytes(size_bytes));\n    }\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// List sessions missing embeddings\nfn run_embed_missing(data_dir: &std::path::Path, json: bool) -> Result<()> {\n    use crate::search::open_index;\n    use crate::vector::EmbedState;\n\n    let state_path = data_dir.join(\"state\").join(\"embed-state.json\");\n    let embed_state = EmbedState::load(&state_path).unwrap_or_default();\n\n    // Get all session IDs from Tantivy index\n    let tantivy_index = match open_index(data_dir) {\n        Ok(idx) => idx,\n        Err(_) => {\n            println!(\"Tantivy index not found. Run 'agentscribe scrape' first.\");\n            return Ok(());\n        }\n    };\n\n    let reader = tantivy_index.reader().map_err(|e| {\n        crate::error::AgentScribeError::DataDir(format!(\"Failed to create reader: {}\", e))\n    })?;\n    let searcher = reader.searcher();\n    let (_schema, fields) = crate::index::build_schema();\n\n    let mut missing_sessions = Vec::new();\n\n    // Collect all session IDs from Tantivy\n    use tantivy::collector::TopDocs;\n    use tantivy::query::AllQuery;\n\n    let all_docs: Vec<_> = searcher\n        .search(\n            &AllQuery,\n            &TopDocs::with_limit(searcher.num_docs() as usize),\n        )\n        .map_err(|e| crate::error::AgentScribeError::DataDir(format!(\"Search failed: {}\", e)))?;\n\n    for (_score, doc_addr) in all_docs {\n        if let Ok(doc) = searcher.doc::<tantivy::TantivyDocument>(doc_addr) {\n            if let Some(session_id) = doc.get_first(fields.session_id).and_then(|v| v.as_str()) {\n                if !embed_state.is_session_embedded(session_id) {\n                    let project = doc\n                        .get_first(fields.project)\n                        .and_then(|v| v.as_str())\n                        .map(|s| s.to_string());\n                    let agent = doc\n                        .get_first(fields.source_agent)\n                        .and_then(|v| v.as_str())\n                        .unwrap_or(\"unknown\")\n                        .to_string();\n\n                    missing_sessions.push((session_id.to_string(), agent, project));\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    if json {\n        use serde_json::json;\n        let output: Vec<_> = missing_sessions\n            .into_iter()\n            .map(|(id, agent, project)| {\n                json!({\n                    \"session_id\": id,\n                    \"agent\": agent,\n                    \"project\": project\n                })\n            })\n            .collect();\n        println!(\"{}\", serde_json::to_string_pretty(&output).unwrap());\n    } else {\n        if missing_sessions.is_empty() {\n            println!(\"All sessions have embeddings.\");\n        } else {\n            println!(\"Sessions missing embeddings:\");\n            for (id, agent, project) in &missing_sessions {\n                println!(\"  {} [{}]\", id, agent);\n                if let Some(ref proj) = project {\n                    println!(\"    Project: {}\", proj);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// Per-plugin status data\nstruct PluginStatus {\n    name: String,\n    sessions: usize,\n    events: u64,\n    last_scraped: Option<chrono::DateTime<chrono::Utc>>,\n    source_paths: Vec<String>,\n    source_files: usize,\n    bytes: u64,\n    truncation_limit: Option<u32>,\n    // Subagent session tracking\n    subagent_sessions: usize,\n    subagent_events: u64,\n}\n\n/// Daemon status info\nstruct DaemonStatus {\n    running: bool,\n    pid: Option<u32>,\n}\n\n/// Index stats\nstruct IndexStats {\n    exists: bool,\n    documents: usize,\n    size_bytes: u64,\n}\n\n/// Check daemon status by reading PID file\nfn get_daemon_status(data_dir: &std::path::Path) -> DaemonStatus {\n    let pid_file = data_dir.join(\"agentscribe.pid\");\n    if let Ok(content) = std::fs::read_to_string(&pid_file) {\n        if let Ok(pid) = content.trim().parse::<u32>() {\n            // Check if process is actually running\n            unsafe {\n                // kill(pid, 0) checks if process exists without sending a signal\n                if libc::kill(pid as i32, 0) == 0 {\n                    return DaemonStatus {\n                        running: true,\n                        pid: Some(pid),\n                    };\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    DaemonStatus {\n        running: false,\n        pid: None,\n    }\n}\n\n/// Get index stats\nfn get_index_stats(index_dir: &std::path::Path) -> IndexStats {\n    let tantivy_dir = index_dir.join(\"tantivy\");\n    if !tantivy_dir.exists() {\n        return IndexStats {\n            exists: false,\n            documents: 0,\n            size_bytes: 0,\n        };\n    }\n\n    let size_bytes = dir_size(&tantivy_dir);\n\n    // Read actual document count from Tantivy index\n    let documents = match tantivy::Index::open_in_dir(&tantivy_dir) {\n        Ok(index) => match index.reader() {\n            Ok(reader) => reader.searcher().num_docs() as usize,\n            Err(_) => 0,\n        },\n        Err(_) => 0,\n    };\n\n    IndexStats {\n        exists: documents > 0 || size_bytes > 0,\n        documents,\n        size_bytes,\n    }\n}\n\n/// Format bytes as human-readable size\nfn format_bytes(bytes: u64) -> String {\n    const KB: u64 = 1024;\n    const MB: u64 = 1024 * KB;\n    const GB: u64 = 1024 * MB;\n\n    if bytes >= GB {\n        format!(\"{:.1} GB\", bytes as f64 / GB as f64)\n    } else if bytes >= MB {\n        format!(\"{:.1} MB\", bytes as f64 / MB as f64)\n    } else if bytes >= KB {\n        format!(\"{:.1} KB\", bytes as f64 / KB as f64)\n    } else {\n        format!(\"{} B\", bytes)\n    }\n}\n\n/// Format a timestamp as relative time ago\nfn format_ago(ts: chrono::DateTime<chrono::Utc>) -> String {\n    let now = chrono::Utc::now();\n    let duration = now.signed_duration_since(ts);\n\n    if duration.num_days() > 0 {\n        format!(\"{}d ago\", duration.num_days())\n    } else if duration.num_hours() > 0 {\n        format!(\"{}h ago\", duration.num_hours())\n    } else if duration.num_minutes() > 0 {\n        format!(\"{}m ago\", duration.num_minutes())\n    } else {\n        \"just now\".to_string()\n    }\n}\n\n/// Recursively compute directory size in bytes\nfn dir_size(path: &std::path::Path) -> u64 {\n    if !path.exists() {\n        return 0;\n    }\n\n    if path.is_file() {\n        return path.metadata().map(|m| m.len()).unwrap_or(0);\n    }\n\n    let mut total: u64 = 0;\n    if let Ok(entries) = std::fs::read_dir(path) {\n        for entry in entries.filter_map(|e| e.ok()) {\n            let p = entry.path();\n            if p.is_dir() {\n                total += dir_size(&p);\n            } else if let Ok(m) = p.metadata() {\n                total += m.len();\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    total\n}\n\n/// Count files with a given extension recursively\n#[allow(dead_code)]\nfn count_files_recursive(path: &std::path::Path, ext: &str) -> usize {\n    if !path.is_dir() {\n        return 0;\n    }\n\n    let mut count = 0;\n    if let
